action_items: (Nit, non-blocking) In /app/frontend/app/index.tsx lines 22-25, the auto-redirect uses `setTimeout(() => router.replace('/dashboard'), 0)` executed inline during render. This is a side-effect in render body (React anti-pattern) and may cause duplicate navigation on re-renders. Move the redirect into a useEffect that depends on [ready, session].
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses @app.on_event('startup') which is deprecated in FastAPI; prefer lifespan handlers. Non-blocking.
/app/frontend/app/index.tsx: side-effect (setTimeout + router.replace) called during render; should be inside useEffect.
